rationale: Open Targets disease mapping represents lung adenocarcinoma at disease level. KRAS p.G12C is retained as a separate project molecular context and is not attributed to the Open Targets disease ontology.

MONDO_0005184 is the disease-level pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma entity. KRAS p.G12D remains a separate project molecular context and is not attributed to the Open Targets disease-level association score.

MONDO_0018177 captures glioblastoma at disease level. IDH-wildtype remains a separate project molecular context so generic Open Targets association scores are not misrepresented as IDH-wildtype-specific evidence.
Open Targets mapping captures AML at disease level. FLT3-mutant status remains separate and association scores are not interpreted as FLT3-mutant-specific without independent evidence.
